law: Quality picks the model. Cost only breaks a tie.
note: Static public subset of owner authorized read only observations. Fleet and scheduler records were collected September 26, 2026. Atlas is a configuration read, not an inference test. Backup integrity retains its September 24, 2026 observation because the newer detailed report was not retrieved. Counts do not establish application health. Private topology, credentials, spending, model tags and backup coverage counts are withheld. Each fact retains its own date; routing remains unverified.

backups.restoreScope: Full fleet recovery is not established. A historical isolated rehearsal on September 10, 2026 recovered one guest operating system and backup application; datastore contents were excluded.
